technical.summary: DOW shows solid bullish structure with price above key MAs and positive volume, but weak trend strength (ADX 18) and bearish MACD histogram limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: DOW shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 84 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme bearish sentiment (52.9% bearish, Fear score 35) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with no significant insider conviction signals.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (391.84) with FOMC event just passed creates severe near-term volatility headwind; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset to acute risk-off conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish OBV/volume and supertrend confirmation offers structural support, while extreme bearish sentiment (52.9%) and fear-zone VIX create classic contrarian buy setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis regime (391.84) post-FOMC, weak ADX trend strength (18), bearish MACD histogram, zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk in 84 days create severe near-term volatility headwind that overwhelms technical bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive with price above major MAs and bullish volume, but extreme VIX crisis (391.84) post-FOMC creates acute volatility headwind that overwhelms contrarian sentiment opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX regime (391.84) and macro risk-off conditions will likely trigger sharp reversals regardless of technical setup; 84-day earnings proximity adds material uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
